# wcs-card-image



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

The card media component is a container that display an image/icon inside a card. 
On horizontal orientation, the image/icon has an aspect ratio of 1/1
On vertical orientation, the image/icon has an aspect ratio of 16/9.

## Slots

| Slot           | Description                                                            |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
|                | The default slot where the image/icon is displayed                     |
| `"horizontal"` | The slot where the image/icon is displayed when the card is horizontal |
| `"vertical"`   | The slot where the image/icon is displayed when the card is vertical   |
